companies.title: Companies
companies.description: LinkedIn company URLs (most reliable) or plain company names. Processed one at a time, in order.

userDataDir.title: Session profile folder
userDataDir.description: Chrome profile directory created by "npm run login".

liAtCookie.title: LinkedIn li_at cookie
liAtCookie.description: Fallback only (e.g. Apify cloud). Locally, run "npm run login" instead: LinkedIn quickly revokes pasted cookies used in a different browser. Can also come from LINKEDIN_LI_AT.

allEmployees.title: All employees
allEmployees.description: Take everyone on the company's People tab, ignoring the role keywords below. LinkedIn shows at most ~1,000 members per company.

profileDetails.title: Open each profile
profileDetails.description: On: visit every profile for experience, education, about, location and connections (one page per person, slow, counts toward the per-run cap). Off: only name, headline and profile URL from the People tab (fast, hundreds of people in minutes).

hrKeywords.title: HR headline keywords
hrKeywords.description: A person is kept only if their headline contains one of these (whole word, case-insensitive). Leave empty for the built-in list.

peopleSearchTerms.title: People-tab search terms
peopleSearchTerms.description: Terms searched on each company's People tab. Each costs a page load. Leave empty for the default: HR, Talent Acquisition, Recruiter, Human Resources.

maxProfilesTotal.title: Max profiles per run
maxProfilesTotal.description: Hard cap on profile pages opened across all companies, to stay under LinkedIn's per-account daily view limits. People-tab-only rows (Open each profile = off) don't count.

outputFile.title: Output file name
outputFile.description: Written to the working directory (the project root when run locally). Also saved as OUTPUT_XLSX in the key-value store.
